key_insight: Total deformation-based MPM targets numerical fracture in perfectly elastic solids while retaining current-grid force computation for contact handling.
engineering_relevance: The method supports simulation of elastic components undergoing large, recoverable deformations and contact.
method: Compute deformation directly from particle positions using a fixed reference grid, rather than velocity-gradient updates.
Compute elastic forces on the current grid to support standard grid-based collision handling.
Enable particle-level collision handling and zero-energy mode suppression to counter nonlinear deformation artifacts.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports efficient simulation of complex large-deformation elastic contact scenarios, but provides no quantitative benchmarks or error metrics.
watch_item: Robustness and computational cost across contact conditions and discretization resolutions require validation beyond the abstract.
paper_title: Total Deformation-based MPM for Perfectly Elastic Solid Simulation with Strong Deformations
